```{python}
import decoupler as dc
import scanpy as sc
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
```

```{python}
cars = sc.read_h5ad("2.5_car_no_gd.h5ad")
```

# adding a new timepoint category, that splits the late timepoint into late and very late
```{python}
late_dict = {
    "M0":"Product",
    "M01":"Early",
    "M02":"Early",
    "M03":"Early",
    "M04":"Mid",
    "M05":"Mid",
    "M06":"Mid",
    "M09":"Late",
    "M12":"Late",
    "M14":"Late",
    "M15":"Late",
    "M18":"Late",
    "M21":"Late",
    "M30":"VeryLate",
    "M36":"VeryLate",
    "M48":"VeryLate",
    "M60":"VeryLate"
}

cars.obs["timepoint_bin_v2"] = (
    cars.obs["Timepoint"]
    .map(late_dict)
    .astype("category")
)
sc.tl.dendrogram(cars, groupby="timepoint_bin_v2")
```

# also adding pseudotime data generated in slingshot script
```{python}
pt = pd.read_csv("slingshot_pseudotime.csv", index_col="cell")
weights = pd.read_csv("slingshot_lineage_weights.csv", index_col="cell")
weights = weights[["Lineage1", "Lineage3"]]
```

```{python}
pt = pt.loc[cars.obs_names]
weights = weights.loc[cars.obs_names]
```

```{python}
cars.obs["Lineage1_weight"] = weights["Lineage1"]
cars.obs["Lineage3_weight"] = weights["Lineage3"]
```

```{python}
sc.pl.umap(cars, color = ["Lineage1_weight", "Lineage3_weight"])
```

# classifying cells into lineages or branching cells based on their weights
# cells with weigth > 0.8 in lineage 1 and < 0.8 in lineage 2 = lin1 (and vice versa)
# brach cells = those with 0.8 in both, but then excluding earlier clusters to make sure im only capturing the immediate branching point

```{python}
threshold = 0.8

cars.obs["Lineage1_member"] = (cars.obs["Lineage1_weight"] > threshold) & (cars.obs["Lineage3_weight"] < 0.2)
cars.obs["Lineage3_member"] = (cars.obs["Lineage1_weight"] < 0.2) & (cars.obs["Lineage3_weight"] > threshold)
cars.obs["Branch_member"] = (cars.obs["Lineage1_weight"] > threshold) & (cars.obs["Lineage3_weight"] > threshold)
```

```{python}
sc.pl.umap(cars, color = ["Lineage1_member", "Lineage3_member", "Branch_member"])
```

```{python}
cars.obs["lineage_group"] = np.select(
    [
        cars.obs["Lineage1_member"],
        cars.obs["Lineage3_member"],
        cars.obs["Branch_member"],
    ],
    [
        "Lineage1",
        "Lineage3",
        "Branch",
    ],
    default="Other"
)

cars.obs["lineage_group"] = cars.obs["lineage_group"].astype("category")
```

```{python}
sc.pl.umap(cars, color = "lineage_group")
```

# finally, subset out cells that are other, or are too early in the branch
# i'll do that by subsetting out specific clusters
```{python}
to_remove = ["Other"]
car_branch = cars[~cars.obs["lineage_group"].isin(to_remove)].copy()
to_remove = ["Naive/CM T", "Cycling T", "Product Mixed T"]
car_branch = car_branch[~car_branch.obs["labels"].isin(to_remove)].copy()
sc.pl.umap(car_branch, color = "lineage_group")
```

```{python}
collectri = pd.read_csv("../CollecTRI_regulons.csv")
collectri.head()
```

```{python}
dc.mt.ulm(data=cars, net=collectri, layer = "logcounts")
```

```{python}
score = dc.pp.get_obsm(adata=cars, key="score_ulm")
score
```

```{python}
df = dc.tl.rankby_group(adata=score, groupby="timepoint_bin_v2", reference="rest", method="t-test_overestim_var")
df = df[df["padj"] < 0.05]
df
```

```{python}
n_markers = 5
source_markers = (
    df.groupby("group")
    .head(n_markers)
    .drop_duplicates("name")
    .groupby("group")["name"]
    .apply(lambda x: list(x))
    .to_dict()
)
source_markers
```

```{python}
plt.close("all")
plt.figure(figsize=(24,8))
sc.pl.matrixplot(
    adata=score,
    var_names=source_markers,
    groupby="timepoint_bin_v2",
    dendrogram=False,
    standard_scale="var",
    colorbar_title="Z-scaled scores",
    cmap="RdBu_r"
)
plt.savefig("tf_enrichment/all_timepoints_tfs_heatmap.png", dpi=300)
plt.close()
```

```{python}
gex_dn = cars[cars.obs["Timepoint_bin"] == "VeryLate"].to_df().mean(0).to_frame().T
score_dn = score[score.obs["Timepoint_bin"] == "VeryLate"].to_df().mean(0).to_frame().T

dc.pl.network(
```

```{python}
late = df[(df["group"] == "VeryLate")]

top_up = late.nlargest(10, "stat")
top_down = late.nsmallest(10, "stat")

plot_df = pd.concat([top_down, top_up])
plot_df["name"] = plot_df["name"].cat.remove_unused_categories()
plot_df = plot_df.sort_values("stat")
```

```{python}
order = plot_df.sort_values("stat")["name"]
plt.figure(figsize=(8,6))
sns.barplot(plot_df, x = "stat", y = "name", hue = "stat", palette="RdBu_r", order=order)
plt.savefig("tf_enrichment/verylate_top_de_tf.png", dpi=300)
plt.close()
```
